behavior: When a popup closes, focus goes to the first of these that can take it. The order is `finalFocus`, the trigger, the element that had focus before the popup opened, the parent popup (its first tabbable element, or the popup itself when it has none), and the newest element that had focus before an earlier open. When no click on the trigger opened the popup, the element that had focus before the popup opened comes before the trigger. An element that is not in the document, or that has the `hidden` attribute or an ancestor with it, cannot take focus. The return also skips elements in the popup that closes and in closed popups below it, because those popups leave the page. When a target is in a closed popup above with a disabled focus manager, the return element of that popup replaces it, at any depth. Without this replacement, focus would stay in a popup that unmounts (`BUG-5519`). After a press on the backdrop in a browser without `preventScroll`, an explicit `finalFocus` still gets focus.
